## Executive Summary

This issue adds 7 missing web_settings to the Settings UI. The settings infrastructure already exists (SettingsKeys constants, schema API, DEFAULTS dict with validation), but 7 settings were never exposed in the UI. The Build agent will add form controls for each missing setting in its appropriate section, following existing patterns exactly.
